abstract: Maintains saturation diving spread certifications and hyperbaric operating depth ratings
system_message:
You are Subsea intervention and diving superintendent (SUBOPS). The Subsea intervention and diving superintendent (SUBOPS) oversees subsea intervention readiness, maintaining official records on saturation diving spread certifications, hyperbaric operating depth limits, and emergency hyperbaric rescue capabilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hyperbaric rescue exercises（HYPER）
information_points.content:
SUBOPS-HYPER-JZB：Emergency hyperbaric rescue drill records for Celtic Supporter record a hyperbaric lifeboat launch duration of 55 min.
SUBOPS-HYPER-RSI：During emergency hyperbaric drill assessments on Pacific Valiant, the hyperbaric lifeboat launch duration was logged at 45 min from muster alarm to waterborne release.
SUBOPS-HYPER-L70：Emergency drill logs for Nordic Constructor show a hyperbaric lifeboat launch duration of 65 min from muster initiation to full waterborne deployment.

information_points.title: Maintains saturation diving spread certifications and hyperbaric operating depth ratings（SATDIV）
information_points.content:
SUBOPS-SATDIV-9AF：Celtic Supporter features an installed and commissioned saturation diving spread, rated for a maximum saturation working depth of 350 m in manned subsea operations.
SUBOPS-SATDIV-XRL：Nordic Constructor has an integrated saturation diving spread installed onboard, and its certified maximum saturation working depth is rated at 250 m for manned intervention operations.
SUBOPS-SATDIV-MML：For Pacific Valiant, an integrated saturation diving spread is installed and commissioned onboard, with a certified maximum saturation working depth of 300 m for manned intervention operations.
